text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to establish an accessible loading zone on the west side of Rosewell Avenue, between Glengrove Avenue and Glencairn Avenue. The proposed accessible loading zone will provide curb-side access for Wheel-Trans vehicles. This designation will address the needs of a resident and will result in the loss of one parking space on this section of Rosewell Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate at all times on the west side of Rosewell Avenue, between a point 53 metres south of Glengrove Avenue and a point 6 metres further south.
